taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-03, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-03, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note: Station H-03 (Area H)**

A 5-layer geoelectric model is interpreted for drilling:
- **Layer 1** (0–0.90 m, 193.6 Ω·m): Topsoil.
- **Layer 2** (0.90–4.08 m, 129.1 Ω·m): Unsaturated overburden.
- **Layer 3** (4.08–4.87 m, 29.1 Ω·m) & **Layer 4** (4.87–31.51 m, 29.8 Ω·m): Thick, low-resistivity weathered zone, representing the primary aquifer target.
- **Layer 5** (>31.51 m, 165.4 Ω·m): Resistive basement rock.

Evaluating consecutive triplets gives:
- Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3 \rightarrow$ **Q**
- Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4 \rightarrow$ **H**
- Layers 3–4–5: $\rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5 \rightarrow$ **A**

The layer progression correctly corresponds to a **QHA** curve type, fully consistent with the classification on file.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
